The product's refusal text (log) does not name the level, and the only visible messages were the model's paraphrases ('approvals are disabled'), which don't either. That the product's text never reached the screen (no command cell; pty.raw has no 'Not run') is recorded but not judged on its own (amendment v3 R-2: #900 is not in this candidate). Executor verdict blocked (it took the paraphrases for model declines); the model did not decline, it tried and the product refused, so G-1 does not apply. The missing cell is #900 item 4 (merged after this candidate); the missing level name is #941.
